comments.text: Great spot at the gas station, there is signal and you are at the intersection of two roads from where people might go to the east. A 4x4 took us in the back of his car to Jijoca de Jericoacoara.
comments.textEn: Great spot at the gas station, there is signal and you are at the intersection of two roads from where people might go to the east. A 4x4 took us in the back of his car to Jijoca de Jericoacoara.
comments.textFr: Super endroit à la station-service, il y a un signal et vous êtes à l'intersection de deux routes d'où les gens pourraient aller vers l'est. Un 4x4 nous a emmenés à l'arrière de sa voiture jusqu'à Jijoca de Jericoacoara.
comments.textEs: Gran lugar en la gasolinera, hay señal y estás en la intersección de dos carreteras desde donde la gente puede ir hacia el este. Un 4x4 nos llevó en la parte trasera de su coche hasta Jijoca de Jericoacoara.
comments.textDe: Toller Ort an der Tankstelle, es gibt Signal und Sie befinden sich an der Kreuzung zweier Straßen, von wo aus die Leute möglicherweise nach Osten fahren. Ein Geländewagen brachte uns auf der Rückbank seines Wagens nach Jijoca de Jericoacoara.

comments.text: so hard to hitchhike in Brazil but as soon as you start talking to Guayanese folk it was easy enough guayanese in the gas station I marked heading to lethem that we had an easy time getting a ride

comments.textDe: Es ist so schwierig, in Brasilien per Anhalter zu fahren, aber sobald man anfängt, mit Guayana-Leuten zu reden, war es einfach genug, Guayaner an der Tankstelle zu treffen, die ich auf dem Weg nach Lethem markierte, dass es uns leicht fiel, eine Mitfahrgelegenheit zu bekommen

comments.text: We were hitchhiking at the end of the gas station. A car going out of the car station took us directly to Curitiba, but I believe the cars on the rodovia have enough space to stop. The gas station is accessible with the bus 032 from the métro station "Vila Sonia".
comments.textEn: We were hitchhiking at the end of the gas station. A car going out of the car station took us directly to Curitiba, but I believe the cars on the rodovia have enough space to stop. The gas station is accessible with the bus 032 from the métro station "Vila Sonia".
comments.textFr: Nous faisions du stop au bout de la station-service. Une voiture sortant de la gare routière nous a emmenés directement à Curitiba, mais je pense que les voitures sur la rodovia ont suffisamment d'espace pour s'arrêter. La station-service est accessible avec le bus 032 depuis la station de métro "Vila Sonia".
comments.textEs: Estábamos haciendo autostop al final de la gasolinera. Un coche que salió de la estación nos llevó directamente a Curitiba, pero creo que los coches de la Rodovia tienen suficiente espacio para detenerse. Se puede acceder a la gasolinera con el autobús 032 desde la estación de metro "Vila Sonia".
comments.textDe: Wir trampten am Ende der Tankstelle. Ein Auto, das von der Autostation abfuhr, brachte uns direkt nach Curitiba, aber ich glaube, dass die Autos auf der Rodovia genug Platz zum Anhalten haben. Die Tankstelle ist mit dem Bus 032 von der Metrostation „Vila Sonia“ erreichbar.

comments.text: Depoia de tentar por mais de três horas debaixo das mangueiras da rotatória anterior, aqui encontrei minha sorte. Uma direra pra BH, comecei a pegar gosta pela Adrnalina, ainda mais depois que começamos a entrar na metropolitana. Nunca tinha visto uma metropolitana tão industrial, tensa e intensa na minha vida. Com tantos morros e desmorros.
comments.textFr: Depoia de tentar por mais de três horas debaixo das mangueiras da rotatória anterior, aqui encontrei minha sorte. Uma direra pra BH, comecei a pegar gosta pela Adrnalina, ainda mais depois que começamos a entrar na metropolitana. Nunca tinha visto uma metropolitana tão industrial, tensa e intensa na minha vida. Com tantos morros e desmorros.
comments.textEn: Depoia de tentar por mais de três horas debaixo das mangueiras de rotatória anterior, aqui meti minha sort. Uma direra pra BH, comecei a pegar gosta pela Adrnalina, ainda mais depois que we começamos enterar na metropolitana. Nowadays, we see a metropolitan area that is industrial, tense and intense in my life. How both morros and desmorros.
comments.textEs: Depoia de tentar por mais de três horas debaixo das mangueiras de rotatória anterior, aqui meti minha sort. Uma direra pra BH, comecei a pegar gosta pela Adrnalina, ainda mais depois que começamos enterar na metropolitana. Hoy en día vemos un área metropolitana industrial, tensa e intensa en mi vida. Cómo tanto morros como desmorros.
comments.textDe: Stellen Sie sicher, dass Sie mehr als drei Stunden lang die Mangueiras de Rotatoria vorher abgestellt haben. Uma direra pra BH, Comecei a pegar gosta pela Adrnalina, ainda mais depois que we começamos enterar a metropolitana. comments.text:
We wanted to go to Foz do Iguaçu so it may have been better to hitch at the exit of Guarapuava instead of the entrance. The spot near the roundabout is great because it's after a speed bump on the highway. You can signal to the drivers on the highway, and those who exit the gas station. There is enough space for cars and truck to park for a few minutes.

We got a ride from a truck driver to Foz do Iguaçu! 🚚
comments.textFr:
We wanted to go to Foz do Iguaçu so it may have been better to hitch at the exit of Guarapuava instead of the entrance. The spot near the roundabout is great because it's after a speed bump on the highway. You can signal to the drivers on the highway, and those who exit the gas station. comments.textEn:
We wanted to go to Foz do Iguaçu so it may have been better to hitch at the exit of Guarapuava instead of the entrance. The spot near the roundabout is great because it's after a speed bump on the highway. You can signal to the drivers on the highway, and those who exit the gas station. There is enough space for cars and trucks to park for a few minutes.

We got a ride from a truck driver to Foz do Iguaçu! 🚚
comments.textEs:
Queríamos ir a Foz do Iguaçu así que quizás hubiera sido mejor hacer autostop en la salida de Guarapuava en lugar de en la entrada. El lugar cerca de la rotonda es genial porque está después de un badén en la autopista. Puede hacer señales a los conductores en la autopista y a quienes salen de la gasolinera. Hay suficiente espacio para aparcar coches y camiones durante unos minutos.

¡Un camionero nos llevó a Foz do Iguaçu! 🚚
comments.textDe:
Wir wollten nach Foz do Iguaçu, daher wäre es vielleicht besser gewesen, am Ausgang von Guarapuava anzukuppeln als am Eingang. Die Stelle in der Nähe des Kreisverkehrs ist großartig, da sie nach einer Bremsschwelle auf der Autobahn liegt. Sie können den Autofahrern auf der Autobahn und denen, die die Tankstelle verlassen, ein Zeichen geben. Es gibt genügend Platz für Pkw und Lkw, um dort für ein paar Minuten zu parken.

Wir wurden von einem LKW-Fahrer nach Foz do Iguaçu mitgenommen! 🚚
